content.title: About
content.content: Brown rice blended with corn is a whole‑grain product made from whole brown rice kernels and whole corn kernels. It retains the bran and germ, making it more nutritious than white rice. The flavor is mildly nutty with a hint of sweet corn, and the texture is slightly chewy.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Brown rice retains more B‑vitamins and minerals than white rice.
Corn adds extra fiber and antioxidants to the blend.
The mixture is popular in Asian and Latin American cuisines as a base for side dishes and salads.
When stored properly (dry, cool place) it stays fresh for up to a year.
Combining rice and corn provides a more balanced amino‑acid profile.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Both brown rice and corn supply soluble and insoluble fiber that supports healthy digestion.

items.title: Source of complex carbs
items.content: The blend offers sustained energy release, helping maintain stable blood‑sugar levels.

items.title: Contains magnesium and phosphorus
items.content: These minerals are essential for bone health, muscle function, and nerve signaling.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Corn provides carotenoids, while whole‑grain rice contributes phenolic compounds that protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Supports cardiovascular health
items.content: Fiber and beneficial phytochemicals help lower cholesterol levels.

items.title: Corn allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to corn.

items.title: Phytic acid content
items.content: Phytic acid in whole grains can reduce the absorption of certain minerals when consumed in large amounts.

items.title: Higher glycemic index when finely milled
items.content: If the product is heavily processed, its glycemic index may increase.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Cook the rice‑corn blend like regular rice, or use it in salads, pilafs, soups, or as a side dish for meat and fish. Rinse under cold water before cooking to remove excess starch.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in an airtight container in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. For longer shelf life, store in the refrigerator.
